Roman dates count inclusively, so subtract one less than the stated number from the reference day.

1. ante diem III Kalendas Martias → 3 days before 1 March inclusive = 27 February → 27.02  
2. pridie Idus Octobres → day before 15 October = 14 October → 14.10  
3. ante diem VI Nonas Maias → 6 days before 7 May inclusive = 2 May → 02.05  
4. ante diem XVII Kalendas Ianuarias → 17 days before 1 January inclusive = 16 December → 16.12  
5. ante diem VIII Idus Iulias → 8 days before 15 July inclusive = 8 July → 08.07  
6. ante diem XI Kalendas Iunias → 11 days before 1 June inclusive = 22 May → 22.05
